name: RSI(2) >= 90 BTC short with RSI-dependent trailing stop
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_short: RSI(2) >= 90: place sell-stop order at the signal bar low (stop = low), cancel if not filled within 3 bars.
exit: Short exit: stop at the signal-bar high; trailing stop with trail_points 200 (100 if RSI<=30, 80 if RSI<=20) and offset 20 points; pending stop-sell orders cancelled after 3 bars.
stop_loss: Initial stop at signal-bar high; trail described in exit.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Script title itself warns the profit may be erroneous (trail/tick-order emulation); treat as unvalidated. Point-based trail needs asset-specific scaling.
